title: The Develop Mastermind: Coaching for Builders Doing £750k to £5m
meta_description: A minimum 12-month coaching programme for UK construction business owners turning over £750k to £5m. The DEVELOP method, an AI toolkit built for builders, and a private community.
image_alt: The Develop Mastermind coaching programme for UK construction business owners

videos.name: James Overton on structuring a growing construction group
videos.description: James describes moving from successful builder to business owner by putting clearer structures and procedures across a design, build and development group, alongside plans to grow towards £4 million.

videos.name: Mike and Nick on systems supporting business growth
videos.description: Mike and Nick explain how systems and back-office support helped them move from roughly £35,000 to about £80,000 a month and expand from two tradesmen and a labourer to a team of eight.

videos.name: Stephen and Salina on operating systems and sales growth
videos.description: Stephen and Salina describe how operating systems improved visibility as the business moved from about £800,000 annual turnover to just over £900,000 in sales in one December.

videos.name: Dominic Marchant on targets and developing a site manager
videos.description: Dominic explains how targets and accountability improved financial visibility and helped an existing labourer develop into a site manager.

videos.name: Valy Stan on delegation and freeing owner time
videos.description: Valy describes how putting processes in place and delegating more work freed most of his time, reduced operational involvement and supported better profit retention.

videos.name: Lukas on larger projects and life balance
videos.description: Lukas explains how a clearer lead and conversion process helped him move from £50,000 to £100,000 jobs towards a £250,000 minimum project target, while improving his work-life balance.

videos.name: Bradley Wheaton on architect relationships and growth
videos.description: Bradley explains how direct relationships with architects reduced reliance on paid lead sites as the business moved from £440,000 turnover towards an £800,000 target.

videos.name: Dale Marshall on accountability and turnover growth
videos.description: Dale describes how clearer target projects, weekly accountability and community support accompanied turnover roughly doubling in about a year.

videos.name: Richard Abrahams on systems and accountable growth
videos.description: Richard explains how brand guidelines, planning, contracts, HR, safety and marketing systems supported a pipeline of 62 customers waiting for work at the time of recording.
